reference_sql:
SELECT UPPER(REPLACE(sku, ' ', '')) AS supplier_sku, product_id, sku AS stored_sku
FROM products
WHERE UPPER(REPLACE(sku, ' ', '')) IN ('VM-000002', 'VM-000005', 'VM-000006', 'VM-000022', 'VM-000087')
alternatives:
SELECT s.supplier_sku, p.product_id, p.sku AS stored_sku
FROM (VALUES ('VM-000002'), ('VM-000005'), ('VM-000006'), ('VM-000022'), ('VM-000087')) AS s (supplier_sku)
JOIN products p ON UPPER(REPLACE(p.sku, ' ', '')) = s.supplier_sku

WITH cleaned AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, sku, UPPER(REPLACE(sku, ' ', '')) AS clean_sku
  FROM products
)
SELECT clean_sku AS supplier_sku, product_id, sku AS stored_sku
FROM cleaned
WHERE clean_sku IN ('VM-000002', 'VM-000005', 'VM-000006', 'VM-000022', 'VM-000087')

solver.query:
WITH supplier(supplier_sku) AS (VALUES ('VM-000002'), ('VM-000005'), ('VM-000006'), ('VM-000022'), ('VM-000087'))
SELECT s.supplier_sku, p.product_id, p.sku AS stored_sku
FROM supplier s
JOIN products p ON upper(replace(p.sku, ' ', '')) = s.supplier_sku
